sections.excerpt:
Use of proceeds The selling securityholder will receive all of the net proceeds from this offering. We will not receive any proceeds from the sale of ADSs in this offering. We will, however, bear the costs incurred in connection with the registration of these
ADSs. Upon the exercise of the Warrant for cash, we will receive the exercise price of the Warrant. The exercise price of the Warrant is $1.9314 per ADS. American Depositary Shares Each ADS represents one ordinary share, nominal value $0.000042 per share. ADSs may be evidenced by American Depositary Receipts, or ADRs. The depositary will hold the ordinary shares underlying the ADSs in a custody account with the custodian,
